'''Byblos Drive Yards''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer based in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region industrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]].

==History==
Based in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region, Byblos Drive Yards established itself as a regional [[starshipwright]] best known for producing [[Transport/Legends|transports]], [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], and industrial mining and construction [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Its subsidiary [[Byblos RepulsorDrive]] produced combat [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] for use by planetary defense and security forces.<ref name="EGVV" />

The company was an old one; it was flourishing as early as [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. At that time, its products were held to be of questionable quality, but its technicians were easily bribed to make legal and illegal adjustments in their products.
